purpose: Record the Nigerian cable-car project as local sector and role-context evidence without claiming that a controller vacancy or completed system exists.

sources.name: Lagos Metropolitan Area Transport Authority cable-car service and Lagos Cable Car Transit project
sources.scope: Proposed and planned cable-car/ropeway mass-transit infrastructure in Lagos, Nigeria
findings: LAMATA describes a cable-car corridor for Lagos, and the Lagos Cable Car Transit project documents ropeway mass-transit infrastructure.
sources.limitations: The project record is infrastructure and sector evidence, not proof of a completed system, a current operator, or a controller vacancy.

skills.name: Monitor and support automated or ropeway transit operations, passenger safety, alarms, communications and controlled responses to faults
skills.limitation: The Nigerian sources establish planned cable-car infrastructure, not a completed local job market or universal controller requirements.

tools.name: Ropeway control, monitoring, communications, alarm, emergency, maintenance and incident-reporting systems
tools.limitation: The exact system depends on the technology supplier and operating authority.

competencies.name: Keep an automated passenger-transport system within approved safety limits and escalate abnormal conditions promptly

certifications.name: Applicable ropeway, rail, electrical, mechanical, control-room or transport-safety training required by the operating authority
certifications.issuer: Operating authority, technology supplier, NBTE, recognised institution or approved provider
certifications.limitation: No Nigerian personal certification requirement for this exact canonical title was established in the checked sources.

regulatory_requirements.name: Cable-car operations must follow applicable Nigerian transport, engineering, passenger-safety, emergency, occupational-safety and infrastructure requirements
